question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: The choice changes model-visible context, retry semantics, transcript/session state, plugin SDK expectations, and channel ownership, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Shared typed delivery contract
options.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

options.title: Tool/status only
options.body: Limit the work to structured agent and message-tool result status without injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep narrower status paths
options.body: Leave CLI, cron, Teams, sessions_send, restart recovery, and diagnostics as the supported behavior and close or rescope the broader request later.

recommendation.title: Shared typed delivery contract
recommendation.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history on the central agent/outbound delivery status paths and can route product input from the related maintainer-owned delivery semantics thread.
